what_it_is: ARCH-IE 4.0 is the backend and browser workspace that runs Bryant Systems' software agents. It dispatches tasks to registered workers, records each result as an artifact with a receipt, verifies that result by hash before showing it as succeeded, enforces permission decisions on the server, and keeps projects, sessions and evidence intact across a server restart. Its screen-to-server contract is frozen at revision forge.workspace.v1+v4-foundation.4. Proposa, the grant-proposal product, is the first product packet built on that contract.

decision_today.summary: The ARCH-IE 4.0 foundation passed its full 15-check acceptance run on 2026-10-22 and again, independently, on 2026-10-24. The new Proposa screens (commit 427420eb) also pass that run, but four targeted checks the run does not cover all fail on them: only the first 100 sessions or messages are ever loaded, a button labelled as an identical retry can send edited data under a new request identity, and a slow reply can draw one session's transcript under another session's name. Each would cost a research office lost access, a duplicate record, or a transcript under the wrong session. The package therefore stays unmerged until the frontend owner corrects the defects, the focused checks and browser evidence pass, and the full acceptance run is repeated on the corrected commit. Nothing was deployed and no production code changed in this review.
